item.title: Hyundai, Kia Develop In-Car Bacteria And Odor-Fighting Plasma Light
item.description: Hyundai Motor Company and Kia Corporation unveiled “Plasma Care UVC,” the world’s first in-vehicle sanitization technology that uses a plasma lamp to sanitize the vehicle cabin environment and reduce odors, even while passengers are present. Read More »

item.title: Lexus' Crafts & Bonds Continues Father's Day Tribute This June 27-28
item.description: In celebration of Father’s Day, Lexus invites guests to its “Crafts & Bonds: A Father’s Day Tribute.” The two-day pop-up experience is happening 2 to 5 PM on Saturday, June 27 to Sunday, June 28 at Lexus Mitsukoshi. Guests may attend on either day. Read More »

item.title: Ford Chooses The Bear To Test The F-150 Security Package
